records.title: INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT IN NER
details: In Meghalaya, we have proposed one circuit, that is, Guwahati-Shillong-Sohara-Nongriat. This place, Nongriat, is famous for the root bridges. So, we have proposed this Circuit, and we also plan to train our guides and make the logos.

records.title: DEVELOPMENT OF TIRUPATI AIRPORT AS INTERNATIONAL HUB
details: The Minister inter-alia replied as under I would definitely give it in writing also as to when we can do it.
